maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from wholesale used-vehicle marketplace transaction fees and floorplan financing (AFC), not repair or maintenance of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are dealers, OEMs, fleet and rental companies and lenders paying marketplace fees and finance charges; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through marketplace volume and services; past acquisitions (ADESA, TradeRev, CarsArrive) were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers and sellers can use competing auctions like Manheim or ACV; switching marketplaces is relatively easy, though floorplan and integrations add some friction.

notes: Switching difficulty is borderline because of AFC financing and workflow integrations.
